title: Thames Water’s Creditors Submit Revised Plan to Rescue Utility
content: A group of Thames Water’s senior creditors has submitted a new operational plan to the UK regulator as part of its bid to rescue and take over the ailing utility.

title: Kraft Heinz’s Split Plan Prompts Downgrade Review From Moody’s
content: Kraft Heinz Co.’s investment-grade credit rating is being reviewed for a potential downgrade by Moody’s Ratings after the company’s plan to split its business raised uncertainties over its future capital structure.

title: Brazil Sells $1.75 Billion in Debt in Busiest Year Since ’14
content: Brazil tapped international debt investors for a third time this year — its busiest for sovereign bond sales in more than a decade — as borrowers return to global credit markets.

title: What Is the Mortgage Fraud Lisa Cook Is Accused Of?
content: President Donald Trump has moved to fire Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook following a claim by a top administration official that she may have engaged in so-called mortgage occupancy fraud by falsely labeling a secondary home as her primary residence to get better loan terms. Cook hasn’t been charged with any crimes, but the allegation put a spotlight on what experts say is a relatively common type of financial misconduct.

title: Africa’s Food Needs, Debt Costs Create Nightmare For Lenders
content: Africa’s poorest countries are struggling to take on more debt to invest in agriculture and are increasingly faced with the stark choice of paying off costly loans or feeding their people, global development leaders have warned.
